summary: Incremental archive-move recovery in index_repair without full rebuild

delivery.outcome: Allow stored-baseline incremental reconciliation in planfile/core/index_repair.py to recover bounded multi-sprint archive moves (including newly created daily history files and history-locations.yaml updates verified against indexed ticket sprints) without triggering full archive rebuilds, while preserving fail-closed fallbacks on ambiguous/corrupted locators and leaving store.py and sqlite_index.py untouched.
nonGoals: Do not modify planfile/core/store.py or planfile/core/sqlite_index.py (reserved by active foreign tickets).
Do not weaken GET /tickets/discovery read-only isolation or rebuild inside GET handlers.
Do not accept locator-only edits without an in-memory locator snapshot or locator changes affecting sprints outside the bounded changed-sprint set.

architecture.decision: Extend _stored_baseline and reconcile_index in planfile/core/index_repair.py to accept up to 4 changed/new sprints with verified locator deltas checked against the read-only SQLite sprint projection (preferring ticket_operational), and raise bounded byte/ticket caps to 32 MiB / 2048 tickets for end-of-day multi-MB daily history rotations while preserving fail-closed fallback on every ambiguous or out-of-scope locator mutation.
architecture.rollback: Revert planfile/core/index_repair.py and tests/test_index_repair.py to acceptedBaseSha.

validation.evidence: Auto-archive moving completed tickets from current into an existing or newly created history-YYYY-MM-DD sprint with updated history-locations.yaml reconciles via server._repair_ticket_index() with zero full archive scans and restores GET /tickets/discovery to HTTP 200.
Missing locator, locator-only change without changed sprints, and out-of-scope locator mutation pointing to an unchanged history sprint all return None and fall back to full rebuild.
All existing index_repair and discovery tests pass unchanged.
